endpoint_contracts.mirix_embedding: A dedicated 1536-dimensional endpoint is mandatory; wrong dimensions reject before adapter construction.

machine_checks: checker and image SHA-256 match before construction
frozen source checkout is clean and source commit is recorded
required endpoint dimensions match before adapter construction
adapter reset, two-turn ingestion, end_session, snapshot, fact retrieval, and visual retrieval all execute
snapshot and both retrievals are non-empty
image-required methods expose the fixed image through a visual snapshot or retrieved image path
MIRIX exposes at least one real memory partition
every root is sealed terminal-accepted or terminal-rejected with a SHA-256 inventory
scheduling: Execute sequentially only after the Wave-1 controller and its services have released the GPU stack.
result_boundary: This gate produces engineering evidence only and never populates a comparison-table numeric cell.
